candidates.change_summary: Delete the line that sets acc.unlockTime, so the unlockTime remains its default value (0) after Put, which will change the behavior of Collect and thus indirectly change the observable behavior of Put as defined in the target.

Replace the unlockTime assignment with a statement that sets it to _unlockTime unconditionally (ignoring the block.timestamp check), so it can be set to a past time allowing immediate Collect and changing the state after Put.

Delete the entire nonReentrant_ modifier body by removing the require and both locked_ assignments, making Put always reentrant and allowing reentrant calls that can change the contract balance or state during Put execution before the call completes, thus changing the observable state after Put.
Delete the locked_ = true; statement inside the modifier, breaking the reentrancy lock so that Put can be reentered before finishing, which can change the final state after the call.

Delete the locked_ = false; statement, so the lock stays true after the first use, permanently preventing any further calls to Put or Collect and thus changing the behavior of Put calls after the first one.
Remove the unlockTime check condition so Collect succeeds regardless of unlock time
Remove the `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` statement so balance is not deducted on successful collect
Remove the `if (_s)` condition so balance is always deducted even when the external call fails
Remove the `nonReentrant_` modifier from Collect, enabling reentrant calls that could drain balance multiple times
Change `>=MinSum` to `<MinSum` so Collect succeeds when balance is below minimum instead of above
Change `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` to `block.timestamp<=acc.unlockTime` so funds can be collected only before unlock time
Change `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` to `acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` so the balance increases on collect instead
Change `msg.sender.call{value: _am}` to `msg.sender.call{value: 0}` so no ETH is actually transferred on collect
Remove the `locked_ = true;` statement, breaking the reentrancy guard so reentrant calls are not blocked
Remove the `locked_ = false;` statement so the contract stays locked after the first call
